eval_math_responses: evaluate model responses against ground truth math answers using math_verify parse and verify
parse_math_answer: parse a math answer string into a normalized form using math_verify parse for comparison
verify_math_correctness: verify if a parsed model response matches the parsed ground truth math answer
run_math_evaluation: run math evaluation on a row containing answer and response fields to get accuracy score
refactor_eval_math: refactor eval_math to support additional response formats or scoring strategies
